description: A simple and user-friendly protocol for the cryopreservation of coconut pollen. The method facilitates the breeding of programmes involving high-yielding palms and can be effectively utilized in breeding programmes and in vitro studies

Coconut breeding and hybrid development programs
Long-term storage of elite coconut pollen
Germplasm conservation and genetic resource management
In vitro research and plant biotechnology studies
Development of high-yielding coconut varieties
